## Requirements (contract)

1. **Deterministic per-compartment SQLite FTS5 indexes** built from released
   eligible records — one per licence compartment, emitted into the release
   namespace and covered by `sig.release-integrity/1`; normalized
   record/identifier/facet tables; `search_index_version` binds the format
   to the publication descriptor (ADR-132 identity).
2. **Search the complete eligible corpus** of a selected
   (publication, compartment) — every eligible released record type
   including unlocated sites and `unreported` (known-unknown) jurisdiction;
   exact identifier lookup; normalized facets; cursor pagination; ≤50 rows /
   ≤100 KiB body; 2 s hard deadline; explicit 422/409/503.
3. **Read-only API serving** from verified local index files — manifest
   bytes+sha256 verification once per namespace, `meta` contract + identity
   check, per-request `mode=ro` connections; 503 readiness for
   cold/missing/corrupt; **no current-only PostgreSQL fallback** for
   release-scoped requests.
4. **No-JavaScript HTML search route** + complete static browse pagination;
   all links release-scoped.
5. **Strict release/compartment isolation + withdrawal enforcement at
   access time** — denies filtered before pagination; release/artifact deny
   → 410; rollback-safe.
6. **Benchmark at representative scale** — all compartments of the national
   corpus, 8 readers; staging, disk cache, memory, concurrency; measured
   separately from network transfer and index download.

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- No deploy/publish/live exposure (GATE-G3; `live_verification=false`).
- No search cluster, no index download into the browser, no cross-
  compartment federation, no rights/source flips, no human labels, no
  spine writes, no forked shared schemas/functions, no rewriting landed
  ADR bodies/prior run evidence.

## Design (ADR-133)

- **Index artifact** (`exports.search_index`, `sig.release-search-index/1`):
  `records` + contentless `records_fts` (`unicode61` over label/entity_id/
  source_id/jurisdiction), `identifiers` (entity id + record key + all claim
  ids), `facets` (kind/jurisdiction/source/location/technology), `meta`
  contract (tokenizer, sort `label-type-id/1`, cursor v1, scope counts,
  sqlite_version). Canonical insert order + pinned pragmas → sha256-
  identical rebuilds.
- **Query engine**: FTS `MATCH` with quoted tokens; identifier short-
  circuit; no-`q` browse over `(label_sort, entity_type, entity_id)`;
  keyset cursor binding publication/compartment/query+filter fingerprint/
  last key; bounds `limit ≤ 50`, body ≤ 100 KiB (`truncated`), 2 s deadline
  via progress handler + per-row check → `query_timeout`; `query_too_long`/
  `query_too_short`/`unsupported_query`/`malformed_cursor` ⇒ 422,
  `cursor_context_mismatch` ⇒ 409.
- **Serving** (`api.release_search`): `ReleaseSearchStore` — manifest
  verify once per namespace → per-request ro connection → contract +
  identity check → search; denied entity/claim sets recomputed per request
  and filtered before pagination; `route_access` on the descriptor gives
  the 410 namespace barrier. Wired in `create_app(store, release_search)` +
  `sig-api serve --release-registry`.
- **Dedupe fix** — `_iter_unique_site_rows`: the UNIQUE record_key
  surfaced 4,369 duplicate `portal` site rows (same deployment re-
  extracted under a second rights registration); dedupe before projection
  (first occurrence + claim-id union), counted in `site_rows`/
  `duplicate_rows_dropped`; pass-1 projection roots, emitted tree and
  search index all see the same unique record set — fixes the latent
  P32.13 "duplicate record keys" validation failure on the national corpus.
- **Web**: `/search` static GET forms per compartment (`format=html` to
  `/v1/releases/<pub>/compartments/<comp>/search`, origin overridable via
  `SIG_RELEASE_SEARCH_BASE`), complete static browse links, island
  reframed as capped progressive enhancement with an honest cap note;
  `getEntityCompartments` gives listed sites release-scoped record hrefs.

### Self-review findings → fixed in-run

- **Duplicate record keys on the real corpus** — the first national build
  hit `UNIQUE constraint failed: records.record_key`: `portal` carries
  4,369 duplicate site rows (same entity re-extracted through a second
  rights registration). Pre-P32.14 the build would have emitted colliding
  routes + a `records.index.jsonl` that `validate_release` flags. Fixed by
  `_iter_unique_site_rows` (dedupe before projection, claim-union, honest
  counts); regression test `test_duplicate_site_rows_dedupe_to_one_record`.
- **Shared sqlite connection across request threads** — the 8-reader
  benchmark deadlocked on a single shared `mode=ro` connection (cpython's
  sqlite3 cannot iterate one connection from concurrent cursors). The API
  now opens a fresh verified ro connection per request; benchmark mirrors
  it.
- **100 KiB body bound** added inside the engine (`truncated` + cursor
  re-mint) — was previously implicit.
- **Short-q jurisdiction resolution** now `COLLATE NOCASE` and applies the
  *stored* facet value — a lowercase "on"/"dc" resolves, a non-facet short
  string still 422s.
- **`limit` bound** moved fully into `parse_params` so out-of-range values
  share the uniform `{detail, code}` 422 shape.
- Response gains explicit `truncated` flag.
